validate_agent_name: validate an agent name string against the pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$ and raise ValueError on invalid input
load_agent_config: load an agent config from a YAML file in the agent directory into an AgentConfig Pydantic model
load_agent_soul: read the SOUL.md personality file for a named agent and return its content as a string
list_custom_agents: scan the agents directory for subdirectories with config.yaml and return a list of AgentConfig objects
build_agent_config: build an AgentConfig Pydantic model with name, description, model, tool_groups, and skills fields
